## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in West Mifflin, United States. It starts at 4800 Kennywood Blvd..

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Step into the heart of Pittsburgh's cherished Kennywood. Feel the radiance of over two million twinkling lights and admire the majesty of Pennsylvania's tallest Christmas tree. Enjoy a diverse array of festive foods and heartwarming holiday drinks.
>
> Experience the magic of Pittsburgh's iconic theme park, Kennywood. With a rich history of 125 years, this National Historic Landmark amusement park offers more than a mere day of fun.
>
> Explore the charming blend of timeless allure and modern excitement within the park, home to eight heartbeat-raising roller coasters, an exquisite Kiddieland with 12 magical rides, and themed areas inspired by *Thomas & Friends™* and the *Pittsburgh Steelers*.

## Where this page comes from
